metadata.dcterms:title: CENTRAL EXTENSIONS OF GERBES
metadata.dcterms:creator: YEKUTIELI, AMNON
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We introduce the notion of central extension of gerbes on a topo- logical space X. We show that there are obstruction classes to lifting objects and isomorphisms in a central extension. We also discuss pronilpotent gerbes. These results are used in the paper [Ye] to study twisted deformation quanti- zation on algebraic varieties.
